headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: High-contrast, expressive tech. Use font-light (300) for large text mixed with font-bold (700) for emphasis. MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for sizes > 32px.

code.strategy: For SQL/Python editors and code snippets.

colors.strategy: ELECTRIC & NEON Archetype. True navy/black (#0D1117) canvas with highly saturated, minimal accents. Use layered elevation.
rules: No full-screen gradients. Use pure colors.
Tint neutral greys with blue to match the navy background.
Hover states must be explicitly styled and lighter than active states.
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating elements. Use Solid #151B23.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky headers and modals: bg-[#0D1117]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-lg.
visual_enhancers.premium_lock: Overlay premium content with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0D1117]/50. Center a gold badge using yellow/gold gradients (e.g., from-yellow-400 to-amber-600) for text and icons.
visual_enhancers.gamification: Use high-contrast electric blue for XP bars and emerald green for streak counters. Add subtle drop-shadows to active streaks/rings.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High-contrast text on primary background. Primary buttons use #00D4FF with black text.
components.cards: Borderless or 1px subtle border. Flat background (#151B23). On hover: -translate-y-1, border-white/20, shadow-lg.
components.navigation: Visible links on desktop (no hamburger). Glassmorphism background. Include user XP, Level, and Streak in the header.
components.practice_layout: Strict grid hierarchy. Left sidebar for questions, center/right for editor and preview.
components.roadmap: Vertical timeline layout using grid or flex column with connecting lines (1px #30363D border-l).
components.editors: Use dark theme for code editors. Style the Run button with secondary color (Emerald Green).
components.shadcn_overrides: Override shadcn default radii to rounded-md. Override popover backgrounds to #151B23 with #30363D borders.

grids.bento_strategy: For the homepage features, use a High-Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3. Span primary modules 2 columns and secondary 1 column to create asymmetry.
grids.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 or gap-8 between layout sections.

layouts.hero: Left-aligned text (H1 + subtitle + CTAs) with a subtle abstract data visualization background on the right or behind. max-w-7xl mx-auto.
layouts.module_page: Full-height (h-screen) flex/grid layout. Sidebar (w-80) border-r, main content flex-1.
layouts.roadmap_page: Centered timeline, max-w-4xl mx-auto. Grouped by months.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
Staggered entrance animations for feature cards and roadmap items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Use #F8FAFC for text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (already installed). Use Crown, Shield, Zap, Flame for gamification.
media.images: Use images sparingly. Rely on abstract backgrounds for the hero.

hero_background.description: Abstract blue lines and dots. Apply opacity 0.2 and mix-blend-screen to avoid overpowering text. Use in Hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.

Install required fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap');
Set the Tailwind CSS variables in index.css to match the Dark Theme palette provided in this JSON.
Implement the 5 feature cards using the bento grid strategy.

For the SQL and Python editors, mock the visual interface if the actual library (SQL.js/Pyodide) is too complex to wire up fully in the MVP, but make it look fully functional with a 'Run' button and output terminal.
For the Lock UI overlay, apply a backdrop-filter blur with a z-index and absolute positioning over the premium content.
Use lucide-react icons for badges: Flame for streaks, Zap for XP, Crown for Premium.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
